content: Uptime Kuma vs Healthchecks.io: Uptime Kuma actively probes (HTTP/TCP/DNS) and renders status pages, notification channels, and history charts; Healthchecks.io is a dead-man's-switch/heartbeat monitor - the monitored job pings a URL, and absence of the ping on schedule triggers the alert. Uptime Kuma also has a Heartbeat/push monitor type. Both ship a per-channel 'Send test notification' action. Takeaway for a local monitor: an active-probe status view plus a heartbeat/liveness signal are distinct and complementary; absence-of-signal must itself be an alertable condition.
